title: Minimum Moves to Get a Peaceful Board
description:
Given a 2D array rooks of length n , where rooks[i] = [x i , y i ] indicates the position of a rook on an n x n chess board. Your task is to move the rooks 1 cell at a time vertically or horizontally (to an adjacent cell) such that the board becomes peaceful . 
 
 A board is peaceful if there is exactly one rook in each row and each column. 
 
 Return the minimum number of moves required to get a peaceful board . 
 
 Note that at no point can there be two rooks in the same cell. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: rooks = [[0,0],[1,0],[1,1]] 
 
 Output: 3 
 
 Explanation: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/06/17/ex1-edited.gif] 
 
 Example 2: 

 Input: rooks = [[0,0],[0,1],[0,2],[0,3]] 
 
 Output: 6 
 
 Explanation: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/06/17/ex2-edited.gif] 

 Constraints: 

 1 <= n == rooks.length <= 500 
 
 0 <= x i , y i <= n - 1 
 
 The input is generated such that there are no 2 rooks in the same cell.
